methodNote: baseline = the tool before Phase B (bedrooms and property type only; the size and MLS rules switched off); size25_item2 = the same tool with the Phase B rules on (size band 25% and the furnished / short-term / 55+ rules), run by the real lib/ code and proven identical, lease by lease, to the earlier simulation (backtest/phase-b-equivalence.js)

scope.county: the Ventura-area service box (Ventura, Oxnard, Camarillo, Simi Valley, Thousand Oaks and the Conejo Valley border); about 27% of the leases are in the Calabasas / Agoura Hills / Westlake Village / West Hills border area (by the old city list; also reported separately as "LA-border cities"); by the MLS county field about 21% are in counties other than Ventura (reported as "Other counties (LA-border area)")

pool.mls: MLS closed leases from CRMLS (Recore) dated before the day each lease closed, 6-month lookback
pool.full: MLS leases plus as-of asking listings (original list price) plus Rincon's own leases (24-month lookback)
pool.rentcast: not included (RentCast as-of snapshot, A2, is not built); RentCast is about 45% of the comps staff see
pool.timing: as of the day before the lease closed; staff price a home at listing time (median gap 33 days in this data), so the figures are optimistic

regions.definition: "LA-border cities" are Westlake Village, Agoura Hills, Calabasas, West Hills, Woodland Hills, Malibu, Hidden Hills, Canoga Park, Agoura, Los Angeles; "Ventura-area excluding LA-border" is every other city in the box

counties.definition: "Ventura County" and "Other counties (LA-border area)" are grouped by the county the MLS records for each lease (CountyOrParish), so Westlake Village homes on the Ventura side count as Ventura County; a lease whose record has no county is placed by the old city list (Westlake Village, Agoura Hills, Calabasas, West Hills, Woodland Hills, Malibu, Hidden Hills, Canoga Park, Agoura, Los Angeles count as other counties) and is counted under unknown. Grouping only: no comp rule and no headline number uses the county.

westlakeVillage.note: Westlake Village leases tested, split by the MLS county; a count under 20 is not published (null)

rincon.description: Rincon single-home leases started in the last 12 months after the plausibility screen, each typed as a house, condo or townhouse by what the MLS says is at its address (LeadSimple's label where the MLS has no clear answer; leases the MLS shows to be some other kind of home are not tested); signed rent is the target; pool = full (24-month Rincon lookback, Rincon leases typed the same way, implausible rents left out)
rincon.note: signed rent is not always market rent: a unit re-priced after sitting vacant signs below its first ask (no asking-price history exists yet, A3)

listingTimeCheck.description: MLS leases re-run as of the day they went on the market instead of the day before they closed
